templates.title: Meeting Summary -> Personal Email (Gmail)
templates.prompt: After every meeting, email me the summary and action items.

templates.title: Meeting Summary -> Personal Email (Outlook)
templates.prompt: After every meeting, email me the summary and action items.

templates.title: Meeting Summary -> Slack channel
templates.prompt: After every meeting, post the summary and action items to a Slack channel.

required_inputs.asks: Which Slack channel should the summary go to?
required_inputs.note: Fills `channel` on zm.connector_mcp.zm_slack.slack_send_message (send_to=channel). The Workflow editor's channel picker stores a channel ID; use the ID when the user gives one, otherwise the channel name they named. Ask before deploying; never guess.

templates.title: Meeting Summary -> Confluence page
templates.prompt: After every meeting, save the summary as a Confluence page.

required_inputs.asks: Which Confluence space should the pages go in?
required_inputs.note: Fills the required `spaceId` on zm.connector_mcp.zm_confluence.confluence_create_page (a space ID, as the Builder space selector stores). Ask before deploying; never guess.

templates.title: Meeting Summary -> Google Docs
templates.prompt: After every meeting, save the summary to a new Google Doc.

templates.title: Meeting Summary -> OneDrive
templates.prompt: After every meeting, save the summary as a file in my OneDrive.

templates.title: Phone call reminder before each meeting
templates.prompt: About fifteen minutes before each of my meetings, call my phone to remind me.

required_inputs.asks: Which of your phone numbers verified in Zoom should Zoom call?
required_inputs.note: The user's own number, verified in their Zoom account (Zoom Profile → Phone), digits only. Ask before deploying; never guess or reuse a number from elsewhere. Calls reach only the user's own verified phone.

required_inputs.asks: Which country calling code is that number under?
required_inputs.note: Calling code such as +1 (the node script prefixes '+' when missing). An ISO code like US is wrong.

templates.title: Customer meetings -> Salesforce opportunity update
templates.prompt: After every customer meeting, update the related Salesforce opportunity.

templates.title: Work-Style Horoscope from recent Zoom activity
templates.prompt: Use my recent meetings to give me a short work-style horoscope.

templates.title: Meeting chat -> Slack
templates.prompt: After each meeting, forward the meeting's chat messages to me in Slack.

templates.title: Meeting reminder -> Gmail
templates.prompt: 15 minutes before each meeting, email me the meeting essentials via Gmail.

templates.title: Meeting reminder -> Outlook
templates.prompt: 15 minutes before each meeting, email me the meeting essentials via Outlook.

templates.title: Meeting reminder -> the meeting's Zoom Chat channel
templates.prompt: 15 minutes before each meeting, post the meeting essentials to the Zoom Chat channel named after the meeting.

templates.title: Meeting reminder -> Slack DM
templates.prompt: 15 minutes before each meeting, send me the meeting essentials as a Slack direct message.
